Doctors.Title: User Authentication and Account Management
Doctors.Description: Enable doctors to register and log in with OTP mobile verification and email verification. Allow doctors to manage their profile information, including name, phone number, email, and profile picture.

Doctors.Title: Patient Management
Doctors.Description: Provide doctors with a list of patients who have granted access via QR code. Allow doctors to access detailed profiles, including visit and consultation histories, of each patient.

Doctors.Title: Consultation Process
Doctors.Description: Enable doctors to start a new consultation session by scanning the patient's QR code to link the consultation to the patient. Provide AI assistance during consultations for real-time analysis and summarization. Allow doctors to generate, review, edit, and approve consultation reports, and share approved reports with patients.

Doctors.Title: Interactive AI for Doctor
Doctors.Description: Allow doctors to prompt the AI agent associated with a patient to retrieve specific information or insights from the patient's conversation history. Use the AI to retrieve and summarize relevant patient history to aid the doctor during consultations.

Doctors.Title: Patient Flags
Doctors.Description: Provide a feature for doctors to view a list of patients categorized by flags based on the patients' onboarding responses. This helps doctors prioritize and manage patient care effectively.

Doctors.Title: Notifications and Alerts
Doctors.Description: Send email notifications to doctors for important actions such as registration, verification, and report approvals. Ensure timely communication of critical updates and actions.

Doctors.Title: Data Security and Privacy
Doctors.Description: Implement robust access control mechanisms to protect patient data. Ensure all sensitive data is encrypted in transit and at rest to comply with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25 laws.

AI System.Title: AI-Driven Onboarding
AI System.Description: Develop an AI agent to interact with patients during the onboarding process. The AI will dynamically ask questions based on the conversation context and store all responses in a structured format.

AI System.Title: Conversational AI for Patients
AI System.Description: Implement a chat interface that allows patients to interact with an AI agent via text or voice. The AI will have access to the entire conversation history to provide informed responses and analyze conversations for emotional and physical well-being.

AI System.Title: AI Assistance for Doctors
AI System.Description: Provide AI assistance for doctors during consultations to analyze and summarize conversations in real-time. The AI will help retrieve relevant patient history and generate structured consultation reports.

AI System.Title: Transformer Model Integration
AI System.Description: Integrate transformer models for handling patient onboarding, summarizing conversation histories, and generating consultation reports. Ensure the models are trained and optimized for these specific tasks.

AI System.Title: Voice and Text Processing
AI System.Description: Utilize OpenAI's API for voice-to-text, text-to-voice, and text generation functionalities. This will enable the AI to effectively interact with users and provide accurate responses.

AI System.Title: AI-Driven Summarization and Analysis
AI System.Description: Implement logic for the AI to summarize long conversations and analyze them for key insights. This includes emotional and physical well-being, medical history, and other relevant factors.

AI System.Title: AI Prompting for Doctors
AI System.Description: Allow doctors to prompt the AI agent associated with a patient to retrieve specific information or insights from the patient's conversation history. This will aid doctors in making informed decisions during consultations.

Patients.Title: User Authentication and Account Management
Patients.Description: Enable patients to securely register, log in, and manage their profile information. This includes email and phone OTP verification during registration and the ability to update profile details such as name, phone number, email, and profile picture.

Patients.Title: AI-Guided Onboarding Process
Patients.Description: Provide an AI-guided onboarding process where patients can start a new visit, answer dynamic questions based on conversation context, and have their responses stored in a structured format. This process will generate a patient summary that can be viewed by both the patient and the doctor.

Patients.Title: Chat Interface with AI
Patients.Description: Implement a chat interface on the patient dashboard that allows patients to interact with an AI agent via text or voice. The AI will have access to the entire conversation history to provide informed responses, analyze conversations for emotional and physical well-being, and summarize long conversations.

Patients.Title: Viewing Historical Data
Patients.Description: Allow patients to view their past onboarding summaries and consultation histories. This includes providing a tab for onboarding history and another for consultation history, where patients can access detailed reports of their interactions and consultations.

Patients.Title: Profile Management and QR Code Access
Patients.Description: Enable patients to manage their profile information and generate a QR code that doctors can scan to access the patient's visit and consultation histories. This feature will be available on the patient's profile page.

Patients.Title: Notifications and Alerts
Patients.Description: Send email notifications to patients for important actions such as registration, verification, and report approvals. This ensures that patients are kept informed about their account activities and medical updates.
